issue_snapshot.title: Home dashboard with balances, people and groups
issue_snapshot.body:
A signed-in user sees in one glance whether they owe or are owed, who with, and which group needs attention, with groups as rich rows.

UI face: signed-in user opens Home and sees net position, per-person owes/owed rows with avatars, and rich group rows with the create action always reachable. Contract face: consumes the shell, tokens, and shared rows/cards/avatars/badges/skeletons from piece 1 unchanged; reads the existing home balance and group queries through the current server path with no new endpoint or data shape. Follows docs/ui.md Home screen structure and states exactly.

**Out of scope**
- Any balance-math, simplification, or query change; numbers come from the existing recompute path
- Group page, expense editor, settle-up, members, activity, and profile screens
- Dark mode

Covers: TR-11, S-8
Part of #31.
Depends on #33.

## Acceptance (from the split)
- **IAC-1** Home shows the app shell plus a balance summary card whose hero number is the net position, with you-are-owed and you-owe totals beside it.
- **IAC-2** Per-person rows show who the user owes and who owes the user, each with an avatar, name, and words-plus-colour direction; group list shows rich rows with name, member count, per-group balance, and chevron.
- **IAC-3** Zero balances read neutral (All settled up style), never debt red; every amount renders in group currency from one formatter with words plus colour, never colour alone.
- **IAC-4** Empty state shows an illustration or icon, one sentence on what Tabs does, and a Create-your-first-group button; loading shows skeleton summary card and group rows with no layout shift; failure shows retry and never presents cached balances as current.
- **IAC-5** Primary Create group action is obvious: header button on desktop and thumb-reachable fixed button on phones; cards stack vertically at 375px and lay out up to 1024px.
- **IAC-6** Row hit targets are 44px, keyboard path and visible focus hold, one h1 with heading hierarchy, icons are lucide-react aria-hidden next to text, and the ui.md checklists pass.

Record the redesign as a new ADR.

acceptance.check: Home shows the app shell plus a balance summary card whose hero number is the net position (owed minus owe, viewer currency, largest text on screen), with you-are-owed and you-owe totals beside it.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Seed two groups with expenses, sign in, open /: hero equals owed minus owe, totals beside it.

acceptance.check: Per-person rows show who the user owes and who owes the user, each with avatar, name, and words-plus-colour direction; group list shows rich rows with name, member count, per-group balance, and chevron; the left-group notice and the All activity link (the only UI path to /activity) are preserved.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Same session: People rows each carry Avatar plus owes-you/you-owe words in lent/owed colour; each group row links to /groups/[id] with count, balance, and chevron; ?left= name renders role=status; All activity reaches /activity.

acceptance.check: Zero balances read neutral (All settled up style), never debt red — including a person row whose cross-group net cancels to exactly zero, which renders neutral settled-up words with no amount; cross-group totals format in the viewer currency and group rows in their group currency, all through formatMinorUnits with data-amount, words plus colour, never colour alone.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Settle a group to zero and check the neutral banner and neutral zero-net person row; spot-check amounts against formatMinorUnits output. Covered by zero-net unit cases in app/home.test.ts.

acceptance.check: Empty state shows illustration or icon, one sentence on what Tabs does, and a Create-your-first-group button that owns the Create action while groups are empty; failure (including every group failing while groups exist) shows the full failure card with retry and never presents cached or zeroed balances as current.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Fresh account sees empty state with a single Create action; stop the database to see the failure card with retry and no numbers.

acceptance.check: Primary Create group action is obvious: group-list section-header button on desktop (AppShell has no action slot and is untouched) and thumb-reachable fixed button on phones, mutually exclusive per breakpoint so exactly one tab stop, with compensating bottom padding; cards stack vertically at 375px and lay out up to 1024px with no horizontal scroll.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Playwright screenshots at 375x812 (fixed bottom button visible, single column, last row not covered) and 1280x800 (section-header button, max 1024 column).

acceptance.check: Row hit targets are 44px, keyboard path and visible focus hold, one h1 (rendered by the page above the cards at text-page, never via Card title which renders h2) with heading hierarchy, icons are lucide-react aria-hidden next to text, and the ui.md checklists pass including long names and large amounts at 375px.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Keyboard-only walk: tab order matches visual order, focus ring visible, rows activatable; axe/aria check for single h1 and labelled controls; run the frontend-design craft checklist and the UX checklist.

acceptance.check: Home consumes the shell, tokens, and shared rows/cards/avatars/badges/skeletons from piece 1 unchanged and reads the existing home balance and group queries through the current server path with no new endpoint or data shape (calls only regrouped into two withDb blocks, the established activity/group-page pattern).
acceptance.how_to_verify: Review: no change to lib/settle, lib/groups/queries, lib/money, components/ui.tsx, components/app-shell.tsx, or globals.css; sdlc:verify passes (typecheck, test:ci, build).

acceptance.check: Loading renders HomeSkeleton (data-skeleton blocks shaped like summary card and rows, aria-busy container, sr-only Loading your balances status) through a Suspense boundary that actually suspends; proven by the streamed-response marker, not by network throttling which PGlite renders useless.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Inspect the served Flight stream for the skeleton marker plus data-skeleton attributes ahead of the resolved content; on real (Neon) latency the skeleton paints first.

acceptance.check: Partial failure honesty: loaded groups render with balances and failed ones show inline retry rows, and whenever any group failed the summary card carries an explicit incomplete-totals note (mirroring the excluded-currency sentence) instead of a bare hero — a number the screen could not compute is never rendered as a number.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Unit case in app/home.test.ts (failed group absent from inputs forces the incomplete note); live single-group failure is not inducible in QA, so the unit case is the proof.

alternatives_considered.approach: Add a root app/loading.tsx skeleton boundary for the whole route.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The boundary would also paint over the static visitor landing on first navigation; a Suspense boundary scoped to the signed-in async child gives skeletons exactly where data loads and nowhere else.

alternatives_considered.approach: Derive member count from balances.length, avoiding any extra read.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: computeNetBalances appends departed ledger participants behind current members, so its length overcounts real membership; listMembers is the group page's own source of truth for who is in the group.

alternatives_considered.approach: Add a batched member-count column to listGroupsForUser.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The issue forbids any new data shape on the server path, and changing a shared query risks its other callers; reusing the existing listMembers read keeps the contract unchanged.

alternatives_considered.approach: Drop the All activity link, the left-group notice, and the exclusion note under a strict reading of follows ui.md Home structure exactly.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The activity link is the only UI path to /activity (account menu links only /profile, the group excerpt does not link out), so dropping it strands TR-10's feed; dropping the exclusion note makes totals silently incomplete; dropping the notice removes the qa/selectors.md assertion surface. All three are additive and stay.

validated_work_order.approach: Migrate only the signed-in half of app/page.tsx to the ui.md Home screen, reusing the existing queries with no new endpoint or data shape (calls only regrouped into two withDb blocks, the established activity/group-page pattern). Read the session eagerly in HomePage exactly as app/activity/page.tsx does, so the Landing/BootFailure branch is decided before anything streams; move listGroupsForUser plus the sequential per-group loop (computeNetBalances, simplifyDebts, plus listMembers for the member count) plus summarizeHome into an async SignedInGroups child rendered inside <Suspense fallback={<HomeSkeleton/>}>, with the failure card and unstable_rethrow living in the child — a Suspense around the current sync child with resolved props would never suspend. Track per-group failures explicitly: groups exist but every read failed renders HomeFailure for the section (never a zero hero over retry rows); some failed renders loaded groups with inline retry rows plus an explicit incomplete-totals note on the summary card mirroring the excluded-currency sentence, because a number the screen could not compute is never rendered as a number. Build components/home-panels.tsx as pure presentational (no hooks, no server-only imports, mirroring groups-panels.tsx): BalanceSummaryCard (hero net owed-minus-owe in viewer currency as the largest text, owed/owe totals beside it, exclusion note naming foreign-currency groups beside the totals, incomplete note when partial, zero rendering neutral All settled up; used without Card title so the page keeps its own h1), PeopleList (Avatar tinted by person.key with name fallback, words-plus-colour direction, zero-net rows neutral settled-up with no amount per the group-page settled-seat treatment, People empty sentence when empty), GroupList (whole-row links with avatar mark, name, pluralized member count, per-group balance in that group currency, ChevronRight; failed groups as inline retry rows), HomeEmpty (EmptyState plus Create-your-first-group, owning the Create action while groups are empty so header/fixed copies are suppressed), HomeFailure (message plus retry to /, no numbers), HomeSkeleton (data-skeleton blocks, aria-busy container, sr-only Loading your balances status). Preserve the left-group role=status notice, the All activity link, and the exclusion note, none of which has any other home. Keep one h1 at text-page rendered by the page above the cards with section h2s, 44px targets, data-amount on every amount (the globals.css tabular hook), and lucide icons aria-hidden. Render the Create action as the group-list section-header button on desktop (AppShell has no action slot and stays untouched) plus a thumb-reachable fixed bottom button on phones, mutually exclusive via hidden/sm:hidden so exactly one tab stop, with compensating bottom padding and safe-area inset treated as unproven work.
assumptions: S-8 names the Home screen contract as written in docs/ui.md, since no S-id list exists elsewhere in the repo.

Piece 1 (issue #33) has landed the shared set used here — Card, Avatar, Badge, ListRow, Skeleton, EmptyState, buttonClasses — present in components/ui.tsx with lucide-react as a dependency; Home is its first screen consumer, not one of a series.
lucide-react exports the icons this screen needs (Users, ChevronRight, Plus, Wallet or Scale for the summary/empty art).
Home group counts per user are small (single digits), so sequential per-group reads stay inside the interactive budget on paper; PGlite hides the real cost locally.
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: The data path is verified in-tree and reused untouched, the shared set exists and is unit-asserted, and every critique claim was re-checked against the code before folding its fix in — so the diagnosis is no longer resting on anyone's assertion. What would move the number up is seeing the skeleton marker in a served stream and a Neon-latency read on the 1+2N loop; what would move it down is the shared set misfitting Home (Card title level, ListRow truncation, Avatar memberId tint) with AC-7 forbidding any ui.tsx change, which would force a fallback composition or a new ticket.
validated_work_order.debate_summary: The critique was right on every material point and I dismissed nothing as unfounded; no finding contradicted a decision in plan/brief.md, which only pins docs/ui.md and prior decisions as-is. Blocking findings 1 (inert Suspense: app/page.tsx resolves everything before returning to a sync child, so the fallback could never paint) and 2 (per-group catch without counting turns a full outage into a confident All settled up over retry rows, since summarizeHome([]) is zeros) forced a rewrite of the loading/failure design around an async SignedInGroups child with counted failures. Majors 3–6 were folded in full: incomplete-totals note when any group fails, preserved left notice plus All activity link plus exclusion note (verified the link is the sole UI path to /activity), neutral zero-net person rows with no amount (today they render you-owe in debt red), and skeleton spec with data-skeleton/aria-busy/sr-only status proven by stream marker instead of throttling, which environment.md proves useless on PGlite. Minors 7–12 were accepted with two refinements: fixed-position precedent exists for overlays (toast/dialog) but not for action buttons, so the fixed Create button stays unproven work; and the shell-header reading of AC-5 was corrected to the group-list section header since AppShell has no action slot. From the critique's regression risks I added one rule neither proposal nor critique specified: every amount keeps data-amount, the globals.css tabular hook. Missed edge cases folded in: empty-state double Create action, foreign-currency zero-balance groups still named, solo-group rendering, retry soft-navigation semantics, and list-growth vs bottom padding.

files.change: Pure presentational Home sections built only from ui.md tokens and the shared ui.tsx set (Card, Avatar, Badge, ListRow, Skeleton, EmptyState, buttonClasses) plus lucide-react icons: BalanceSummaryCard (hero net owed-minus-owe in viewer currency, owed/owe totals, exclusion note, incomplete-totals note, zero neutral; no Card title so the page keeps its h1), PeopleList (Avatar by person.key with name fallback, words-plus-colour direction, zero-net rows neutral with no amount, People empty sentence), GroupList (whole-row links with avatar mark, name, pluralized member count, per-group balance in group currency, ChevronRight, inline retry rows for failed groups), HomeEmpty (EmptyState owning the Create action when groups are empty), HomeFailure (message plus retry, no numbers), HomeSkeleton (data-skeleton blocks, aria-busy, sr-only loading status). Every amount carries data-amount. No data fetching, no hooks, no server-only imports so app/home.test.ts can render with renderToStaticMarkup.
files.why: The shared-set pattern keeps Home from inventing its own spacing, type, or row treatment, and a pure module is unit-renderable under vitest without next/* server modules; naming every preserved element (notice, activity link, exclusion note) and every failure rule here is what stops this slice from silently dropping them.

files.change: Split HomePage into an eager session read (landing vs signed-in decided before streaming, as app/activity/page.tsx does) plus an async SignedInGroups child inside Suspense with HomeSkeleton fallback; move listGroupsForUser, the sequential per-group loop (computeNetBalances, simplifyDebts, listMembers for counts), summarizeHome, the failure card, and unstable_rethrow into the child. Count per-group failures: all failed renders HomeFailure, some failed renders loaded groups with inline retry rows plus the incomplete-totals note. Preserve the left-group role=status notice, All activity link, and exclusion note; keep the single h1 at text-page above the cards with section h2s; render Create in the group-list section header on desktop plus a fixed bottom button on phones (hidden/sm:hidden exclusive, compensating bottom padding), both suppressed while groups are empty. Landing half, BootFailure, guard flow, and the queries themselves stay exactly as they are.
files.why: This is the one file that owns the signed-in Home assembly; the split is what makes the skeleton boundary actually suspend, and counting failures is what keeps partial and total outages honest.

out_of_scope: Any balance-math, simplification, or query change; numbers come from the existing recompute path through unchanged queries and shapes.
Group page, expense editor, settle-up, members, activity, and profile screens.
docs/ui.md and every other approved doc stay untouched; S-8 is implemented, not rewritten.

No change to components/ui.tsx, components/app-shell.tsx, or globals.css: an AppShell action slot, Card heading levels, and any fixed-button system refinement belong to separate piece-1 tickets, not quiet edits inside this one.
qa_script: Run npm run db:seed, then sign up a fresh account so Home starts empty: illustration, one-sentence explainer, and exactly one Create action (no doubled fixed button).

Create two groups in different currencies with expenses between members: hero net, owed/owe totals in viewer currency, the other-currency exclusion note, per-person rows with avatars and owes-you/you-owe words, rich group rows with count, balance, and chevron; follow All activity to /activity.
Append ?left=<name> to / and check the role=status notice; leave a group via the members screen and check the notice names it.
Settle one group fully to zero: neutral All settled up hero, neutral zero-net person row with no amount, never red.

Reload at 375x812 and 1280x800: cards stack on the phone with the fixed Create button thumb-reachable and the last row uncovered; header button on desktop; a very long group name truncates with the amount readable; no horizontal scroll.

Keyboard-only pass with visible focus throughout; then a failure probe (stop the database) for the retry card with no numbers. Single-group failure is not inducible live and is proven by the unit case instead.

Assert the skeleton in the served Flight stream (marker plus data-skeleton attributes ahead of resolved content) rather than by throttling, which PGlite renders useless; on real latency the skeleton paints first.
residual_risks: The skeleton marker may never appear in a locally served stream because PGlite resolves inside the microtask queue; QA asserts the marker in the stream and the paint only on real (Neon) latency.

The loop grows from 1+N to 1+2N sequential reads per Home visit; invisible locally for the same PGlite reason, payable on Neon against the TR-11 1s budget — group counts are small in practice but unproven at the tail.

Retry links point at / via soft navigation to the URL already on screen; if the App Router replays the cached RSC payload instead of refetching, retry looks like it does nothing — the failure probe must confirm the refetch.

Home is the shared set's first screen consumer, so any misfit (Card title level, ListRow truncation, Avatar tint fallback) has no proven fallback inside this ticket; AC-7 forbids touching components/ui.tsx.
Two placeholder seats sharing one display name in different groups share an Avatar tint via the name fallback; cosmetic only, accepted.
The fixed mobile Create button's overlap compensation and iOS safe-area inset have no in-repo precedent; the 375px screenshot with a long list is the proof.
risks: One extra listMembers read per group runs sequentially (PGlite single connection) and adds Neon latency on accounts with many groups against the TR-11 1s budget; group counts on Home are small in practice and the reads stay in the existing loop rather than a new fan-out — but the cost is invisible locally and only shows on Neon, which QA never runs.
The HomePage restructure touches the file the visitor landing lives in, so the landing-half-unchanged promise rests on diff review plus the existing landing assertions, not on structural separation.

Preserving yesterday's elements (All activity link, ?left= notice, exclusion note, data-amount hooks) is now explicit in files[] and acceptance, but each still needs a review pass confirming it survived, since dropping any one strands a feed, a QA surface, honest totals, or tabular figures.
validated_work_order.root_cause: The signed-in Home was built before the ui.md redesign and was never migrated to it: it renders correct numbers through the correct queries but assembles them with its own one-off markup instead of the shared set, tokens, and Home screen structure — and as the critique proved, the naive migration (Suspense around a sync child, uncounted per-group catches) would have shipped dead loading code and dishonest totals.

validated_work_order.understanding: Home (app/page.tsx) serves two screens: the visitor landing, already redesigned, and the signed-in overview, whose SignedInHome still wears pre-redesign markup (raw text-muted/border-muted classes, text-2xl/text-lg headings, inline-styled New group link, person rows without avatars, group rows without member count or chevron, two plain total boxes instead of a hero-net card). The data path underneath is correct and is reused unchanged: listGroupsForUser plus per-group computeNetBalances/simplifyDebts folded by summarizeHome, formatted at render by formatMinorUnits. S-8 is the Home screen section of docs/ui.md, proved via TR-11. Adjudication re-verified every critique claim in-tree and sustained it: a Suspense around the current sync child with resolved props can never suspend, uncounted per-group catches turn a full outage into a confident All settled up (summarizeHome([]) is zeros), skipped groups silently shrink the hero and People rows, the All activity link is the sole UI path to /activity, zero-net person rows render you-owe in debt red today, AppShell has no action slot, Card title renders h2, and network throttling cannot prove skeletons on PGlite.
unknowns: The exact S-8 text, if it lives outside this repo; every clause of it is covered here through the IAC-mapped criteria and the ui.md Home section.
Whether QA seed data mixes viewer-foreign currencies on one Home, exercising the exclusion note; the qa_script covers it explicitly.
Whether a soft navigation to / refetches the RSC payload for retry links; the failure probe must confirm it.
Whether the skeleton marker reaches the locally served stream at all, given PGlite resolves inside the microtask queue; proven only against real latency.
